description: The fast, native code editor and agent workspace
notes: Please disable Wu's auto-update in the settings, otherwise the built-in updater may install the app outside of Scoop's control.

script: if (!$inno) { throw 'innounp.exe was not found on PATH; the innounp dependency failed to install.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to unpack the '{app}' payload (innounp exit code $LASTEXITCODE)." }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to unpack the '{code_GetInstallDir}' payload (innounp exit code $LASTEXITCODE)." }
